description: Land Acquisition - Mirahawatta, Welimade D/S Division, Badulla District - Parawahera, Matara Four Gravets D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations for acquisition for public purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized administrative matters.
